verdict.rationale: Omnara lets users launch, configure, and delegate tasks to AI agents (via dashboard, CLI, API, SDK) with model choice, MCP tools, skills, and subagents, which functions as delegation to an AI assistant. However, Omnara is fundamentally an orchestration/interface layer for external agents (Claude, Codex, etc.) rather than a single built-in assistant, and some users note it's mainly a UI/tunnel wrapper rather than a distinct built-in AI. missing for 10: evidence of a single unified 'built-in' assistant persona (as opposed to bring-your-own-model/agent orchestration), and independent hands-on confirmation of smooth end-to-end task delegation.
